evidence_summary: The public IGF1-ITGA6+ITGB4 row is already represented by graph edge(s) M21B-E000632. The public locators PMID:28873464 and PMID:28190785 are review or review-guided sources and are not treated as the sole primary support; the existing graph edge-source records provide pair-specific IGF1/IGF2-integrin binding, integrin/IGF1R ternary-complex and bounded signaling/output studies.
limitations: Do not add a duplicate edge from the public row or treat an integrin subunit as a free-standing receptor. Preserve the ITGA6+ITGB4 or ITGAV+ITGB3 heterodimer, IGF ligand form, IGF1R crosstalk and assay/species boundaries; the existing edge does not assert a universal intracellular cascade or terminal TF route.
